# Fonts

Self-hosted so that the arranger fetches only its own files (constitution 1.3.0, "Web App
Constraints": privacy) and works offline (spec 002, FR-035).

| File | Font | Weights | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inter-latin.woff2` | Inter (variable) | 400–800 | Google Fonts, latin subset (`fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20`) | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL-Inter.txt` |
| `jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (variable) | 500–700 | Google Fonts, latin subset (`fonts.gstatic.com/s/jetbrainsmono/v24`) | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL-JetBrainsMono.txt` |

The latin subset covers U+0000–00FF, which includes the accented letters of Portuguese titles.
